title: docs(scenarios): an acknowledged roll-up finding on a withheld child is still charged
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D7UBkcmf1Qy7iEMxarYt8wU)_
Fixes #35006

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:场景评测的说明文档写明一条既有计分规则,并加一条测试钉住它,分数不变。
- 属于「MCP 二期与问数」专题:回答作者写了理由的汇总泄漏告警要不要照样扣分。
- 出错时只会让评测里写了理由的泄漏不再扣分,本改动只加文档和测试,可直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

The seat ruled (reading 7062005269, from the maintainer's ruling on #33818): **count as today**. A `security-rollup-source-unreadable` finding that the build acknowledged with `rollupSourceUnreadableReason` is still charged as a failed Build check whenever the card withholds the roll-up's child (or the child field it reads) from that persona. A written reason does not change what the persona sees.

- `packages/qa/scenarios/README.md`, the "Roll-ups over withheld data" bullet: states that rule, and how the acknowledged finding differs on the wire (the `info` arm, the reason appended to the message).
- `packages/qa/scenarios/test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`: one new top-level `describe`, placed right after the existing roll-up charge block. It runs the real `@objectstack/lint` rule on acknowledged permission sets and pins three things. First, the rule answers each finding at `info`, with the `...rollupSourceUnreadableReason` path and the `. Acknowledged on the set: "REASON"` suffix. Second, `rollupSourceCharges` reads every suffixed message without throwing, through both of its readings: the object gate (client_viewer) and the field gate (contractor). It charges each one. Third, as a control, the same build without the reasons is charged for exactly the same roll-ups.
- `.changeset/35006-scenarios-acknowledged-rollup-charged.md`: `patch`, because `README.md` is in the package's `files[]`.

No `src/**` change and no score movement: the runner already charges these findings. This PR writes the rule down and pins it.

## Tests

<details><summary>Readings at the head this PR was opened on</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test && pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck` (under the verify lock): `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `Test Files 40 passed (40)`, `Tests 1211 passed (1211)`, then `tsc --noEmit` clean. A `--listFiles` count of 1 shows that the package's tsc program includes `test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`.
- Targeted: `vitest run test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts -t 'acknowledged roll-up|security-rollup-source-unreadable on a child'` gave `Tests 9 passed`: the 8 existing roll-up charge cases plus the new one.
- No ablation: the diff changes no tested behaviour (a test-only pin plus prose).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The `rollupSourceCharges` docblock in `orchestrate.ts` says "the `info` row-scope arm — is not charged". That is accurate, because it names the row-scope arm. I left it alone, since `src/**` is outside this claim's file surface.
- The commit trailer is the model-free pair the pre-push hook (`check:commit-card-trailers`) requires. The dispatch spelled a model-named co-author, and the hook refused it.

## Verification

Read first: the new `describe` in `packages/qa/scenarios/test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`. The risk hunk is the `charges` assertion: it would fail if the runner ever dropped `info` findings or stopped reading the suffixed message.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts -t 'acknowledged roll-up'` should report 1 passed.
